keyFindings.description: The breaker passes an upload whose new ask was never refused. When the rules check's judged list (an upload leaves out the asks the stored document holds) is shorter than the scan, every scanned ask counts as refused, the held ones included; two refused uploads that each add a different new ask beside a held #window block trip #window, and a third upload adding a never-judged ask is sent unreviewed by the breaker. Reproduced by the quality review (entries verdict/match, verdict/match, breaker). Present since the approved head; fix: count only the asks the rules check judged (parse once, have runRulesCheck return the judged asks).

The rebuttal's trailing shell comment makes Envoy's run-end check count a rebutted dispatch write as work: pi-shared dispatchCommandHead refuses an unquoted '#', so envoy.ts:3110-3125 sets check_due for a rebutted `dispatch comment`, re-arming the ask nudge's stop-time self-check and its reminder. Regression from round 6; reproduced by the deep review (dispatchCommandHead returns undefined on the rewritten command).

AskGate refuses, in block mode, the command it handed back: scopedCommand returns undefined for a head line ending in ` # --advisor-rebuttal '…'`, so resending the recorded call (after a Dispatch-side failure, or copying that form) gets the unreadable refusal, whose text never names the comment. Reproduced by the deep review.

The refusal texts and the Rebuttal doc still say the flag is removed before sending and that the call the agent reads back lacks it, contradicting the new acknowledgement and the command the agent reads back, the exact contradiction rounds 6-8 removed from the acknowledgement.

At session shutdown the Dispatch record (up to RECORD_TIMEOUT_MS, 5 s) runs before appendEntry, while session_shutdown waits SHUTDOWN_WAIT_MS 1.5 s before the host seals the session; a record slower than about 0.5 s loses the advisor-gate entry. Reproduced by the deep review (shutdown returned after 1501 ms with 0 entries; the entry arrived after). Present since the approved head; fix: when closing, append the entry first or bound the record by what remains of the shutdown wait.
